name: liste-cadeaux-ethan-native
description: Applications natives Windows, Android et iPhone pour la liste d'Ethan.

scripts.app:windows: npm run native:prepare && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.app:android: npm run native:prepare && tauri android init && tauri android build
scripts.app:ios: npm run native:prepare && tauri ios init && tauri ios build
